definitions.explanation: One of the two knees, used mostly in describing a kneeling or sitting posture.

examples.english: To go down on one knee.

examples.japanese: {片膝|かたひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit with one knee drawn up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{片膝|かたひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついて、⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{出|だ}した→差し出す：04234_sashidasu⟧。
examples.english: He went down on one knee and held out a ring.

notes:
⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧〜 (one of a pair) + ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片膝|かたひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく: to go down on one knee
- {片膝|かたひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to raise one knee while sitting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧: knee
- ⟦{跪|ひざまず}く→跪く：05536_hizamazuku⟧: to kneel (on one or both knees)
